what: label texts of the graphs generated in Rust

provenance.label: numerical solution of the stated model; not experimental validation
provenance.solver: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference

colours.rule: Method A blue solid, Method B red solid, same thickness; experimental observations black markers; no dashed or dotted lines; plots use a fixed light surface in both themes

r2_display_rule: R²_A = x in blue and R²_B = y in red, from the stored display string, which is rounded toward minus infinity; nothing else inside the plot area: no N, no interval, no status word, no placeholder where no value exists; the reason, the citation and the link stand below the graph (metric-r2.md Sections 7.2 to 7.4)

texts.plain: The kernel-only start (decision 20) differs from the real initial state in two ways with opposite effects: it ignores the inventory already outside the SiC (raises F_p) and the inventory already in the coatings (lowers F_p). The size of the difference is not stated here: the results pipeline computes it for Sr-90 and Cs-137 from the Scenario 5 heating runs against the kernel-only runs of the same histories and writes it into the files curves/s5.refuelling.heating*.json, field kernel_only_comparison. The net direction is not established for Ag-110m and Cs-134.
